notifications_method.label: Notification Method
notifications_method.help: Completion notification method. auto selects automatically by terminal, osc9 sends OSC 9, bel sends terminal bell, off disables notifications.

notifications_threshold_secs.label: Threshold
notifications_threshold_secs.help: Only triggers notification for successfully completed turns with duration ≥ this value, default 30s. Failed/cancelled turns are always silent.

notifications_completion_sound.label: Completion Sound
notifications_completion_sound.help: Completion sound. beep for system default beep, off to disable, bell for terminal bell, file to play custom WAV.
